Duties of securities exchange.-(1), It shall be the duty of a securities exchange to ensure — (a) a fair, transparent and efficient market in securities that are traded on its securities market; and (b) that risks associated with its business and operations are managed prudently. (2) In discharging its duty under sub-section (1), a securities exchange shall- (a) act in the public interest; and (b) ensure that the interest of investor, customer and public at large prevails where it conflicts with the interest of the securities exchange, TRE certificate holder, shareholders, board of directors and management.
